name: codegraph-extension
description: Zero-dependency codebase knowledge graph assistant. Self-contained tree-sitter based AST queries & VS Code Copilot integration.

codegraph.autoUpdate.description: Auto-update the graph in the background when a code file is saved.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Query the codebase graph for context (BFS/DFS traversal)

commands.name: path
commands.description: Find the shortest path between two concepts/symbols

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a specific concept/symbol and its neighbors

commands.name: build
commands.description: Rebuild the graph for the current workspace

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_query
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the workspace knowledge graph using natural language. Returns relevant code structure, dependencies, and file relationships. Use this to find where things are defined, how they connect, or to answer codebase architecture questions.

question.description: A natural language query or keyword search, e.g., 'auth', 'database connection'

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_path
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find the shortest path of relationships between two concepts, files, classes, or functions in the codebase. Use this to understand how component A communicates with or depends on component B.

source.description: The starting concept, file, or symbol name

target.description: The target concept, file, or symbol name

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_explain
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the detailed attributes, files, and surrounding neighbors of a specific codebase concept, file, class, or function. Use this to inspect a particular symbol's definition context and immediate connections.

symbol.description: The class, function, concept, or file name to inspect
